title: Apresentações à mesa
grammar: Am, is e are em apresentações
goal: Escolha a forma de be de acordo com a pessoa apresentada.
old_reading: Ben sits at a table with his friends.
A new student comes to the table.
Her name is Ava.
Ben introduces his friend from school.
They all eat lunch together.
old_dialogue: Are you both in my class?
Yes, we are in your class.

title: Arrumando a mochila
grammar: My e your para dizer de quem é
goal: Coloque my ou your antes do objeto. Use your ao se dirigir a alguém.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
old_reading: Ravi packs his backpack before class.
His notebook is on the desk.
Lia sees a pencil on the floor.
She picks it up and gives it to him.
Ravi puts everything in his backpack.
old_dialogue: My notebook is on the desk.
Yes. Thank you for finding it.
Yes. I just need to pack my bag.

title: No balcão do café
grammar: Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
goal: Monte um pedido com Can I have + item + please.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
old_reading: Lia walks into a coffee shop.
She looks at the menu.
The barista says hello.
Lia asks for a small coffee.
She takes her coffee to a table.
old_dialogue: Can I have a coffee, please?
Can I have a small one?
No, thank you. Can I sit here?

title: Um pão na padaria
grammar: A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
goal: Escolha o artigo pelo primeiro som da palavra seguinte.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
old_reading: Ravi goes to a bakery.
He sees a roll and an egg sandwich.
There is a loaf of bread on the shelf.
Ravi wants bread for his family.
He buys a loaf and a roll.
old_dialogue: Good morning. Is that a loaf of bread?
Can I have a loaf, please?
Sure. Do you want a roll too?
Yes. Is that an egg sandwich?
Yes, it has an egg and cheese.

title: Duas porções no balcão
goal: Use números com o substantivo no plural ao pedir mais de uma unidade.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
pron_sound: /z/ no plural de rolls e muffins
old_reading: Nina goes to the bakery after school.
She sees cookies and muffins behind the glass.
She wants a snack for two people.
Nina buys two rolls and two cookies.
She puts the bag on the table at home.
old_dialogue: Yes. Do you want anything else?
Yes, they are next to the pastries.
Can I have two cookies instead?
Of course. Here are your rolls and cookies.

title: Comprando uma passagem só de ida
goal: Use one para informar quantas passagens quer e a para pedir uma sem enfatizar a quantidade.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
Plural regular com -s
old_reading: Ben needs a train ticket to Boston.
He walks to the ticket counter.
He wants to stay in Boston for a week.
He asks for a one-way ticket.
He puts the ticket in his pocket.
old_dialogue: Can I buy a ticket to Boston?
Do you want the morning train?

title: Pedindo um café para viagem
grammar: I would like para pedir com cortesia
goal: Pratique a forma completa seguida do item que você quer.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
Plural regular com -s
One como quantidade explícita
old_reading: Maya stops for coffee before work.
She has no time to sit down.
She asks for coffee to go.
The server puts a lid on the cup.
Maya takes the cup with her.
old_dialogue: I would like a coffee, please.
Yes, please. I have a long walk.
Yes, a small cup is fine.

title: Conferindo o bilhete impresso
grammar: This e these ao mostrar itens próximos
goal: Use this para um bilhete e these para dois ou mais.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
Plural regular com -s
One como quantidade explícita
I would like para pedir com cortesia
old_reading: Emma has two printed tickets.
She checks the date on both tickets.
One ticket is for today.
The other is for tomorrow.
Emma keeps the right ticket in her hand.
old_dialogue: Yes. I have two printed tickets.
Do I need these two tickets today?
No. Keep this ticket for today.

title: Nomeando objetos à mesa
grammar: That e those para apontar itens mais distantes
goal: Use that com um objeto e those com vários objetos à distância.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
Plural regular com -s
One como quantidade explícita
I would like para pedir com cortesia
This e these ao mostrar itens próximos
old_reading: Dinner is ready at Rose's house.
A plate is next to each glass.
The forks are near Dan.
The napkins are at the other end.
Rose asks Dan to help set the table.
old_dialogue: Can you pass me that plate?
This plate next to my glass?
No, that one across the table.
Yes, the ones at the other end.
Can you bring those forks too?
Yes. I can bring them now.

title: Pedindo água no restaurante
goal: Use some water para falar de uma quantidade indefinida e a glass of water para uma porção.
grammar_taught_before: Am, is e are em apresentações
My e your para dizer de quem é
Can I + verbo para fazer um pedido
A e an antes de substantivos contáveis
Plural regular com -s
One como quantidade explícita
I would like para pedir com cortesia
This e these ao mostrar itens próximos
That e those para apontar itens mais distantes
pron_sound: A vogal de ice e a de glass
old_reading: A server comes to Ivy's table.
Ivy asks for some water.
The server brings two glasses.
One glass has ice.
Ivy takes the glass without ice.
old_dialogue: Can I have some water, please?
Sure. Here is a glass of water.
Can I have a second glass?
Yes. Would you like some ice?
Can I have ice in just one glass?
Of course. Here is the one with ice.
Can I keep the one without ice?
